function: AES S-box, inverse (FIPS 197): the inverse of the affine map with constant 0x63, then inversion in GF(2^8) mod x^8+x^4+x^3+x+1
bit_order: x0 and y0 are the most significant bits (msb/msb), as in NIST's inverse files

nist.compared_with: every inverse AES S-box circuit of the pin (91): aes-invsbox/, sbox/aes-sbox-inv-*, old-2020/aes-sbox-rev-*
nist.pareto_points_note: NIST's Pareto points in (A, AD, G, GD) among the 91 (33 points) that this circuit matches or beats in all four and beats in at least one

checker: circuits/check.py (boolcirc) as at commit 08012e1; search/nonlinear/boolflux/aes_check.py as at commit 08012e1 (BoolFlux core and independent/verify.py, NIST's 91 inverse circuits); and a third evaluator (the table computed from GF(2^8) and the affine map of FIPS 197, written for this check)
